newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-STRIKER RENALDO JOINS BRAZILIANS AT DEPORTIVO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STRIKER RENALDO JOINS BRAZILIANS AT DEPORTIVO.

text.p: A Spanish league dazzled by a contingent of Brazilian stars welcomed a new face on Monday, as Deportivo Coruna signed striker Renaldo from Atletico Mineiro for 340 million pesetas ($2.65 million).
"I'll feel at home here, alongside my countrymen," said Renaldo, 25, who joins Rivaldo, world cup defender Mauro Silva and two other compatriots at Deportivo.
The local Galician language, which is similar to their native Portuguese, has made Deportivo a particularly attractive destination for Brazilian players.
Renaldo will return to Brazil before beginning his three year contract at Deportivo in December.
